# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Be extremely concise. Sacrifice grammar for the sake of concision.

## Project Overview

This is a **SvelteKit 2** web application built for generating OpenCollective invoices. It's deployed to **Cloudflare Workers** using `@sveltejs/adapter-cloudflare` and uses Wrangler for local preview and deployment.

**Core Purpose**: Help users generate properly formatted expense submissions for OpenCollective by following their strict title and description requirements documented in specs.
